# Renovate options

Renovate's options and their `.deps.yaml` equivalents. `deps migrate`, `deps init --from-renovate` and `--renovate` translate a Renovate config by this mapping, see [Migrating from Renovate](../migrating-from-renovate.md). A Renovate option left in `.deps.yaml` is an unknown key, and the error names its deps equivalent, for example `.deps.yaml:3:5: rules[0].matchPackageNames: unknown key (Renovate's matchPackageNames is names here)`.

| Renovate | deps |
|---|---|
| `extends: ["local>org/renovate-config"]`, `github>org/repo//path#ref`, `gitea>…` (shared config presets) | `extends: [org/deps-config]`, `org/repo//path.yaml#ref`, or a git URL (`https://…//path#ref`): a `.deps.yaml`-format file of another repository, decoded strictly, its rules before this file's; see [configuration](configuration.md#extends). `--renovate` and `deps migrate` resolve Renovate presets (built-in ones, `local>`, `github>`, `gitea>`, `forgejo>`) into the translation; `.deps.yaml` does not load Renovate's own presets (`config:recommended`, `group:*`, …): see [built-ins](../migrating-from-renovate.md#presets). The [`deps-config`](managers.md#deps-config) manager updates a tag or commit `#ref` of the entries, as Renovate's `renovate-config` manager updates preset tags (`matchManagers: [renovate-config]` becomes `managers: [deps-config]`) |
| `repositories`, `autodiscover` + `autodiscoverFilter` (self-hosted, one job for many repositories) | `deps run --repositories org/a,org/*` (`$DEPS_REPOSITORIES`; `owner/<glob>` lists an organization's or user's repositories, without archived ones and mirrors; on GitLab `group/**` covers the subgroups, like Renovate's `autodiscoverNamespaces`); see [CI](../ci.md#one-job-for-many-repositories). No onboarding PR: a repository without `.deps.yaml` runs with the defaults (or `--config`) |
| `packageRules` | `rules`: manager blocks (`gomod: {…}`) and update-type blocks (`major: {…}`) become rules too |
| `enabled: false` (package rule) | `rules[].ignore: true` |
| `enabled: true` for disabled-by-default deps | `rules[].ignore: false` (indirect, Elm `test-indirect`, `go` directive, peerDependencies, engines, git submodules: `managers: [git-submodules]`, Azure Pipelines tasks: `{managers: [azure-pipelines], depTypes: [task]}`; uv's `tool.uv.constraint-dependencies`, `tool.uv.override-dependencies`, `tool.uv.build-constraint-dependencies`, which Renovate does not extract) |
| `ignoreDeps` | a rule with `names` and `ignore: true` |
| `matchManagers` | `rules[].managers` (list): `github-actions`, `gomod`, `docker` (covers `dockerfile`, `docker-compose`, `kubernetes`, `helm-values`), `npm` (covers `bun`), `deno`, `helm` (covers `helmv3`, `helm-requirements`, `helmfile`, `argocd`, `flux`, `sveltos`, `fleet`, `helmsman`, `vendir`; Renovate's helmsman needs `managerFilePatterns`, deps finds desired state files among all YAML files), `kustomize`, `pre-commit`, `gitlabci` (covers `gitlabci-include`), `nvm`, `nodenv`, `bun-version`, `asdf`, `mise`, `cargo`, `pip_requirements` (covers `pip-compile`: `*.in` inputs are updated and the compiled files regenerated), `pep621`, `pep723` (every `*.py` file; Renovate needs `managerFilePatterns`), `setup-cfg`, `pip_setup`, `poetry`, `pipenv`, `pyenv`, `runtime-version`, `homeassistant-manifest`, `terraform`, `terraform-version`, `terragrunt-version`, `tflint-plugin`, `terragrunt`, `maven`, `maven-wrapper`, `gradle`, `gradle-wrapper`, `osgi`, `smithy`, `swift`, `mint`, `xcodegen`, `homebrew`, `bundler`, `ruby-version`, `git-submodules`, `rust-toolchain`, `devcontainer`, `conda` (Dependabot's `conda` ecosystem; Renovate has none), `bitbucket-pipelines`, `woodpecker`, `crow`, `droneci`, `circleci`, `azure-pipelines`, `cloudbuild`, `velaci`, `travis`, `buildkite`, `bitrise`, `jenkins` (`registryUrls` of the `jenkins-plugins` datasource are not translated: `DEPS_JENKINS_PLUGINS_URL` names one update site), `vcpkg` (Renovate has none; Dependabot's `vcpkg` ecosystem), `elm` (no Renovate manager; Dependabot's `elm`), `composer`, `julia`, `bazel-module`, `bazelisk`, `nuget`, `cake`, `paket`, `ansible`, `ansible-galaxy`, `sbt`, `scalafmt`, `kotlin-script`, `leiningen`, `deps-edn` (alias deps have dep types `extra-deps`, `override-deps`, `replace-deps`, `default-deps` instead of Renovate's alias name), `ant`, `pub`, `fvm`, `mix`, `gleam`, `nix` (flake inputs; Renovate's `depName` is the input name, which is deps' name too, so `matchDepNames` carries over, while `matchPackageNames` against Renovate's repository URL does not), `quadlet`, `crossplane` (every YAML file; Renovate needs `managerFilePatterns`), `tekton` (every `*.y(a)ml` file with `tekton.dev` resources; Renovate needs `managerFilePatterns`), `glasskube` (every `*.y(a)ml` with a Glasskube resource; Renovate needs `managerFilePatterns`), `cocoapods` (git pods are `git-tags` deps named after the pod, where Renovate uses `github-tags`/`gitlab-tags` with the repository as `packageName`), `jsonnet-bundler` (deps' name is Renovate's depName `<host>/<path>[/<subdir>]`, so `matchDepNames` carries over, while `matchPackageNames` against Renovate's packageName, the remote as written, does not), `copier` (the template; Renovate's `depName` is `_src_path` as written, deps names it `owner/repo`, so match it with `names: ['owner/repo']`), `custom` (covers `custom.regex` and `custom.jsonata`; `depTypes: [jsonata]` narrows to the JSONata managers); `deps migrate` lists the managers of a Renovate rule in one deps rule per set of dep types |
| `matchPackageNames`, `matchDepNames` | `rules[].names` (doublestar globs, case-insensitive as Renovate's minimatch `nocase`, `/regex/` and `/regex/i`; `{/,}**` works as in Renovate; `!pattern` excludes, a list of only exclusions matches every other name) |
| `matchPackagePatterns`, `matchDepPatterns` | `rules[].names` (each regex as `/<RE2>/`) |
| `matchPackagePrefixes`, `matchDepPrefixes` | `rules[].names` (globs such as `prefix/**`; `deps migrate` writes `/^prefix/`) |
| `excludePackageNames`, `excludePackagePatterns`, `excludePackagePrefixes`, `excludeDepNames`, `excludeDepPatterns`, `excludeDepPrefixes` | `!` entries in `rules[].names` (`!name`, `!prefix**`) |
| `matchDepTypes` | `rules[].depTypes` (deps names, see [managers](managers.md); Renovate's `golang` = `go`) |
| `matchFileNames`, `matchPaths` | `rules[].paths` (case-insensitive globs, `!pattern` excludes, as in `names`) |
| `matchCurrentVersion` | `rules[].currentVersion`: a semver constraint (`< 2`) or `/regex/`, `!/regex/` against the locked version, else the current one; not combinable with `versioning` in the same rule |
| `matchCurrentValue` | `rules[].currentVersion` in the regex form: `/re/`, `/re/i`, `!/re/` as written, an exact string `s` as `/^s$/i`; matched against the locked version, else the version as written (the bare version of a range, not Renovate's `^1.2.3`); globs have no equivalent |
| `matchCurrentAge` | `rules[].currentAge` (`> 1 year`, `< 30 days`; a month is 30 days, a year 365): the release time of the current version, looked up only for deps the rule's other selectors match; unknown times match no rule |
| `matchSourceUrls` | not supported: the source repository is only known after a per-dep (for docker: per-image config) lookup; match the packages with `names` instead |
| `matchDatasources` | `rules[].datasources` (`golang-version`, `github-tags`, `github-release-attachments`, `node`, `bitbucket-tags`, `azure-tags`, `bitbucket-server-tags` (`git-tags`) and `github-digest` (`git-refs`) accepted; `artifactory`, `gitlab-releases`, `gitlab-tags`, `gitea-releases`, `gitea-tags`, `forgejo-releases`, `forgejo-tags` and `endoflife-date` for custom-manager deps; `apk` and `deb` for custom-manager deps and the Dockerfile `RUN apk add`/`apt-get install` pins; `sbt-package` and `sbt-plugin` are the sbt manager's, with library names carrying the Scala suffix as Renovate's `packageName` does: `org.typelevel:cats-core_2.13`; `hex`, `hexpm-bob` and `glasskube-packages` under their Renovate names); `github-runners` (with `matchDepTypes: [github-runner]`) selects the `runs-on:` runner labels of the github-actions manager, as in Renovate |
| `matchBaseBranches` | `rules[].baseBranches` (names, `/regex/`; `!` excludes, as in `names`; globs are not supported): the base branch `run` resolves, `explain --base` and `preview --base` (default: the pull request's target); `plan`, `apply`, and `explain` and `preview` without one have none, so such rules match nothing there |
| `matchUpdateTypes` | `rules[].updateTypes`; `pinDigest` = `pin` |
| `matchCategories` | `deps migrate` expands it to the category's managers; in `.deps.yaml` use `managers`/`datasources` (`golang` ≈ `managers: [gomod]` plus `datasources: [golang-version]`) |
| `allowedVersions` | `rules[].allow` (semver constraint or `/regex/`, `!/regex/`) |
| `versioning` | `rules[].versioning` (`semver`, `loose`, `maven`, `ivy`, `ruby`, `nuget`, `hex`, `nixpkgs`, `regex:…`, plus deps' `tag`, `go`, `docker`) |
| `extractVersion` | `rules[].extractVersion`, marker `extractVersion=` (RE2 with a `version` group, same syntax) |
| `replacementName`, `replacementVersion` | same names in `rules`; `replacementNameTemplate` only in the prefix form `{{{replace '<prefix>' '<new prefix>' packageName}}}`, which becomes `rules[].replacementPrefix` and `replacementName` |
| `groupName` | `rules[].group` (`groupSlug` is derived: `slug(group)`); settings shared by the group's rules can go into `groups.<name>` once |
| `schedule` | `schedule` / `rules[].schedule`: Renovate's time windows as written (`before 6am on monday`, `every weekend`, `after 10pm and before 5am every weekday`, `on the first day of the month`, crons with minute `*` like `* 0-5 * * 1`), evaluated against the run time; or crons of the workflow's `on.schedule` triggers (see [behavior differences](../migrating-from-renovate.md#behavior-differences)) |

| `github-release-attachments` digests | a regex `currentDigest` group with datasource `github-release-attachments` is kept current like Renovate: the asset of the current release with that sha256 is found and the same asset of the new release is used; `custom[].checksum.asset` / `checksum.url` name the asset explicitly |
| `hostRules` (tokens) | env tokens, `.npmrc`, Docker credentials, git credential helper; retries are built in. An entry with `enabled: false` (`default:disableHost`, `default:disableDomain`) has no equivalent: deps still looks the host up, exclude its deps with a rule setting `ignore: true` |
| `platform`, `endpoint`, `token` (`RENOVATE_PLATFORM`, `RENOVATE_ENDPOINT`, `RENOVATE_TOKEN`) | detected from the CI environment (`GITLAB_CI`, `GITHUB_ACTIONS`, …) or the `origin` remote (`github.com`, `gitlab.com`, else API probes); override with `run --platform github\|gitea\|forgejo\|gitlab --api-url <endpoint> --token`, or set `DEPS_TOKEN` (`GITLAB_TOKEN` on GitLab). GitLab merge requests use `merge_when_pipeline_succeeds` for `automerge`, pipelines as checks and issues for the dashboard (see [GitLab CI](../ci.md#gitlab-ci)); Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gerrit are not supported |
| `automerge` | `automerge` / `rules[].automerge` (platform auto-merge once required checks pass; a PR automerges when all its updates do) |
| `automergeType: pr`, `automergeType: branch` | `automergeType`: `pr` or `branch` (top level and per rule). `branch` pushes the branch without a PR and fast-forwards the base to it once its checks pass; failed checks or a refused push open the PR. `pr-comment` is not offered |
| `draftPR` | `draftPR` (top level and per rule): GitHub draft PRs; on Gitea and Forgejo the title starts with `WIP: `, on GitLab with `Draft: `. Applied when the PR is created; PRs that automerge are never drafts |
| `prCreation: immediate`, `not-pending`, `status-success`, `approval` | `prCreation` (top level and per rule; a group takes the most waiting mode of its updates): the branch is pushed first and a later run opens the PR once its checks finished or all passed (waiting branches are on the dashboard under *Pending status checks*), or, under `approval` (needs `dashboard.enabled: true`), once it is ticked under *Pending approval* |
| `prNotPendingHours` (top level) | `prNotPendingHours` (default 25, like Renovate's): under `not-pending`, a branch whose checks are still pending or absent gets its PR this many hours after its last commit. In `packageRules` it is ignored (info) |
| `automergeStrategy` | `automergeStrategy`: `auto`, `merge`, `squash`, `rebase` (Renovate's `merge-commit` = `merge`; `fast-forward` and `rebase-merge` are not offered) |
| `platformAutomerge` | always on for PRs: deps automerges PRs through the platform (GitHub falls back to a direct merge once checks are green); with `automergeType: branch` it pushes to the base itself |
| `ignoreTests` | not supported: deps never merges a PR without green checks |
| `labels`, `addLabels`, `reviewers`, `assignees` | same names, top level and per rule: a rule's `labels` replaces the labels, its `addLabels` adds to them. deps has no top-level `addLabels`; the translation (`--renovate`, `deps migrate`, `deps init --from-renovate`) appends Renovate's to `labels` |
| `dependencyDashboard`, `:dependencyDashboard` | `dashboard.enabled` |
| `dependencyDashboardTitle` | `dashboard.title` |
| `dependencyDashboardLabels` | `dashboard.labels` |
| `dependencyDashboardApproval` (top level or in `packageRules`) | `dashboardApproval`: `true` at the top level or in `rules` (needs `dashboard.enabled: true`): no PR until the *Pending approval* checkbox is ticked; security updates need no approval, as with Renovate's `vulnerabilityAlerts` default |
| Mend badges, `security:openssf-scorecard` | not supported (release age as text in PR bodies) |
| repository cache | not applicable (no persistent cache) |
